_meta.title: EngiPath Synthetic Test Personas — V1
_meta.description: Deliverable J — 8 synthetic questionnaire test cases for validating the intelligence layer.
_meta.note: These are NOT real students. Each persona defines a response pattern, expected signal state, expected adaptive behaviour, and expected profile outcome.

test_personas.title: Hidden technical strength
test_personas.description: A student with low self-confidence but substantial technical experience. Independent troubleshooting is strong. Peers frequently ask them for help. The system should detect the self-perception vs experience discrepancy.

key_response_pattern.Q06_note: Selects problem-solving as a perceived strength but with hesitation
key_response_pattern.Q08_note: Self-reports LOW confidence in problem-solving despite evidence
key_response_pattern.Q13_note: Breaks unfamiliar problems into sub-components (strong PS1, strength 0.80)
key_response_pattern.Q20_note: Seeks out extra resources independently (strong LEARN1)
key_response_pattern.Q21_note: Adapts learning strategy when stuck (strong LEARN2)
key_response_pattern.Q28_note: Takes ownership of project scope decisions
key_response_pattern.Q34_note: Moderate idea communication — clear in small groups, less so in large
key_response_pattern.Q45_note: Tries alternative approaches when setback occurs

expected_contradictions: CR01 for PS1 or PS2 — low confidence vs high experience

expected_adaptive_behaviour: System should detect CR01 contradiction: student confidence LOW but PS2 experience HIGH.
Should prioritise an adaptive question that explores whether the student underestimates their troubleshooting ability.
Should NOT prematurely conclude the student is 'underconfident' as a trait.

expected_profile_outcome.PS1_classification: possible_hidden_strength OR developing_picture (depends on aggregated strength after weighting)
expected_profile_outcome.heard_summary_should_include: Your responses suggest you may have more experience in troubleshooting than you give yourself credit for.

test_personas.title: Confidence ahead of evidence
test_personas.description: A student with high self-confidence but limited real experience. Mostly tutorial/guided work. The system should flag 'worth_validating' rather than 'overconfident'.

key_response_pattern.Q06_note: Selects technical skills as perceived strength
key_response_pattern.Q07_note: Identifies time management as development area
key_response_pattern.Q13_note: Tries to solve everything at once rather than decomposing (developing PS1, strength ~0.35)
key_response_pattern.Q14_note: Asks classmate or searches online immediately (developing PS2, strength ~0.30)
key_response_pattern.Q21_note: Sticks with the same approach even when stuck
key_response_pattern.Q34_note: Communicates ideas but only in familiar territory
key_response_pattern.Q35_note: Participates in teams but follows rather than leads
key_response_pattern.Q45_note: Gets frustrated and pauses when setback occurs
key_response_pattern.Q47_note: Prefers structured learning with clear instructions

expected_contradictions: CR02 for PS1 and/or PS2 — high confidence vs low experience

expected_adaptive_behaviour: System should detect CR02: student confidence HIGH but experience evidence LOW.
Should explore whether the student has experiences not yet captured.
Should NOT label the student 'overconfident'.

test_personas.title: Genuine beginner
test_personas.description: A first-year student with low confidence and low experience. Few opportunities to demonstrate capabilities. The system should classify as 'still_taking_shape', never as 'weak'.

key_response_pattern.Q01_note: Curious about mechanical engineering but still exploring
key_response_pattern.Q06_note: Unsure what strengths are — selects 'not sure yet'
key_response_pattern.Q13_note: Would wait for guidance (insufficient PS1 evidence)
key_response_pattern.Q20_note: Hasn't had many learning opportunities outside class

expected_adaptive_behaviour: System should NOT keep asking questions to try to force evidence.
Questionnaire should stop at or near minimum question count.
Profile should preserve unknown areas honestly.

test_personas.title: Well-calibrated experienced student
test_personas.description: A senior student with high confidence backed by strong, consistent experience across multiple signals. Evidence comes from diverse sources.

key_response_pattern.Q07_note: Identifies public speaking as area to develop
key_response_pattern.Q13_note: Strong problem framing — breaks into sub-problems (strength 0.80, behavioural_choice)
key_response_pattern.Q20_note: Strong learning initiative — seeks resources independently (strength 0.75, past_experience)
key_response_pattern.Q34_note: Strong idea communication in technical contexts (strength 0.72)
key_response_pattern.Q35_note: Moderate team contribution — prefers technical roles

expected_adaptive_behaviour: System should confirm alignment between confidence and evidence.
Few or no adaptive questions needed — signals are consistent.
Contextual questions may be selected to improve source diversity.

test_personas.title: Communication misconception
test_personas.description: A student who says 'I'm bad at communication' broadly, but evidence shows strong technical explanation and small-group communication. Only public-speaking confidence is genuinely low. The system must NOT classify ALL communication as poor.

key_response_pattern.Q07_note: Identifies COMMUNICATION broadly as development area
key_response_pattern.Q08_note: Moderate overall confidence, LOW specifically for communication
key_response_pattern.Q34_note: Strong idea communication — explains technical concepts clearly (strength 0.72, COM1)

expected_contradictions: CR04 — broad self-criticism for 'communication' but COM1 evidence is positive
Possibly CR01 if COM1 experience is high enough relative to self-view

expected_adaptive_behaviour: System should detect the broad negative judgement with narrow evidence (CR04).
Should select an adaptive question that unpacks WHICH aspect of communication the student feels weak in.
Should NOT assume ALL communication is poor based on the student's broad statement.

expected_profile_outcome.heard_summary_should_include: Your responses suggest you may have more experience in idea communication than you give yourself credit for.

test_personas.title: Independent preference but good teamwork
test_personas.description: A student who prefers working independently but demonstrates strong team contribution skills. The system must keep preference and capability separate — preferring independence does NOT mean poor teamwork.

key_response_pattern.Q35_note: Strong team contribution despite preference for independence (strength 0.70, COM2)
key_response_pattern.Q49_note: Prefers solo exploration over group study

expected_signal_state.note: PREF1 values must NOT influence COM2 experience_strength

expected_adaptive_behaviour: System should NOT flag 'prefers independence' as a teamwork concern.
No contradiction should be raised between PREF1 and COM2.
Preference and capability must remain in separate sections.

test_personas.title: Contradictory behaviour
test_personas.description: A student who gives one answer suggesting strong problem framing and another suggesting heavy dependency on external direction. The system should flag mixed consistency and trigger adaptive clarification.

key_response_pattern.Q13_note: Strong problem framing — decomposes into sub-problems (strength 0.80, PS1, positive)
key_response_pattern.Q21_note: Sticks with one approach — doesn't adapt (LEARN2, developing, strength 0.30)
key_response_pattern.Q27_note: Needs guidance for complex tasks (EXEC1, developing, strength 0.35)
key_response_pattern.Q41_note: Follows given priorities rather than setting own (MGMT1, developing)
key_response_pattern.contextual_Q15_note: If asked: relies on step-by-step guides when troubleshooting (contradicts Q14 strong debugging)

PS1.consistency: mixed or high (depends on whether contextual Q adds data)

expected_signal_state.note: If contextual questions reveal conflicting PS2 evidence, consistency should drop to 'mixed' or 'low'
expected_contradictions: CR03 — opposing observations for PS2 if contextual question contradicts core

expected_adaptive_behaviour: System should detect mixed/low consistency in PS2 if contextual answer contradicts core.
Should prioritise adaptive question to clarify whether behaviour is context-dependent.
Should NOT average contradictory signals into a misleading moderate score.

test_personas.title: Sparse profile
test_personas.description: A student who answers the minimum number of questions and several areas remain unknown. The system should preserve unknown areas rather than inventing conclusions.

key_response_pattern.note: Student answers 10 questions and skips several. Hard maximum not reached but coverage is low.

expected_adaptive_behaviour: System may ask 1-2 contextual questions targeting highest-value unknowns.
System should NOT force 20 questions just to fill coverage.
If minimum coverage cannot be met, stop and report honestly.

expected_profile_outcome.completion_status: incomplete OR complete with remaining unknowns
expected_profile_outcome.validation_VR01: Unobserved signals have experience_strength null, not 0.0
expected_profile_outcome.validation_VR06: All unobserved/insufficient signals appear in unknowns array

validation_test_matrix._doc: Quick-reference matrix showing which validation rules each test persona exercises.
VR08_llm_clarification_lower: any persona if LLM clarification triggered
